newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CONFRAM SEEKS ROMATEX MERGER - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: CONFRAM SEEKS ROMATEX MERGER - PAPER.

text.p: Consolidated Frame Textiles Ltd, South Africa's largest textile compay, is in talks to take control of Romatex Ltd , Confram chief executive Roy Sable was reported as saying in Business Report on Tuesday.
Romatex, which is 60 percent-owned by C.G. Smith Ltd, is the country's second-largest listed textiles company with interests in cotton and wool fabrics, home textiles, floor coverings and chemicals.

C.G. Smith Ltd said on Monday it was engaged in discussions regarding its stake in Romatex Ltd . At the same time, Confram also said it was in talks which could have an impact on its share price and that of parent Frame Group Holdings Ltd .
